description: Ten original Hospital AMR Operations Assistant cases: five single-turn and five multi-turn. Written to cover behavior the base set does not (on_mission filter, WARD_3A, robot number alias, pickup missions, robot correction, garbled confirmation); none repeat base, extension or adversarial wording.

cases.query: Hiện có robot nào đang chạy nhiệm vụ không?

metadata.what_it_tests: Hỏi thời gian di chuyển dùng get_route_info và map 'nhà thuốc' sang PHARMACY
